verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury pays interest: 2% APY on the Checking Account and up to 4.46% in the Investment Account, invested in money market funds and Treasuries. However, nothing shows interest-bearing balances held in currencies other than USD, and the Banking API docs state "Banking is US-only." International wires and USDC Bill Pay are payment features, not yield-bearing multi-currency balances. Missing for 10: multi-currency (non-USD) account balances, interest earned on foreign-currency holdings, and independent corroboration.
